_comment: PER-IMAGE PROVIDER RATES, IN USD. THIS FILE IS A QUOTE, NOT A CONTRACT.
These are the published list prices as of the authoring model's Jan-2026
knowledge cutoff. Nothing in this repo can verify them — the runner prints
the rate it used and the date below on every dry run, and REFUSES to bill
unless --i-have-confirmed-pricing is passed, precisely so a stale number
here can never quietly become a real charge.
Confirm against the provider's own pricing page before authorising a run.
